title: Trailheads
description: Trailheads in Sandy, Utah area. 20 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Name
table:columns.description: Name of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 18 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Address
table:columns.description: Street address of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 20 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Maintenance
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 3 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Parking_Stalls
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 16 distinct values, ranging 0 to 131.

table:columns.name: Elevation
table:columns.description: Elevation of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 20 distinct values, ranging 4309 to 5390.

table:columns.name: Brochure_ID
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 20 distinct values, ranging 1 to 20.

table:columns.name: Status
table:columns.description: Operational status of the feature. See the measured values below, because the source layer declares no code list. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 2 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Latitude
table:columns.description: Latitude copied into an attribute. The geometry column is authoritative and is not in degrees for most of this catalog. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 20 distinct values, ranging 40.54 to 40.5894.

table:columns.name: Longitude
table:columns.description: Longitude copied into an attribute. The geometry column is authoritative. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 20 rows, 20 distinct values, ranging -111.917 to -111.775.

table:columns.name: Shape
table:columns.description: Residual Esri geometry field. It carries no coordinates here; the geometry is in the `geometry` column.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
